title: Mobile typed authorization holds, but mutation completion and signed-receipt truth are not atomic
scope: src/angerona/modules/mobile_bridge.py typed state-change authorization and its Combat/EventBus completion boundaries
controls_held: All seven mutator forms rejected missing, stale, future-dated, and replayed transport identities in a 28-case independent matrix.
Admin nonce sender binding, monotonic expiry, first-use consumption, PIN verification, and five-attempt/900-second lockout held.
Admin nonces remain inside the ECO_ON/ECO_OFF/LOCKDOWN domain and cannot authorize alert-token commands.
Alert tokens are 256-bit random values and held their stored sender, action-set, expiry, and single-use boundaries.
KILL/SUSPEND/ROLLBACK share the typed alert authorization gate; the downstream exact source/target and consumer receipt checks remain present.
With a stable armed EventBus, mobile change receipt events carry verifiable HMAC signatures.

residuals.title: ECO rollback can fail while a signed receipt claims no cadence change
residuals.evidence: A setter mutated to 6.0 and raised; its compensating setter also raised. The HMAC-valid receipt said rejected/no change, the target remained 6.0, and a governor initially at 4.0 was changed to the hard-coded fallback 1.0 because prior_governor is captured only after module apply succeeds.
residuals.impact: Monitoring/resource cadence can be partially changed while authoritative operator evidence reports the opposite.
residuals.recommendation: Snapshot before mutation, serialize the transition, postverify every target, verify every compensation, and emit an exact signed partial/rollback_failed terminal state with red health whenever atomic restoration cannot be proven.

residuals.title: A timed-out Combat directive can mutate the host after a signed rejection
residuals.evidence: The bridge publishes the live directive, waits three seconds, then records rejected/no action without cancelling or changing the admitted request. A later exact verified Combat row still satisfies _receipt_ids.
residuals.impact: LOCKDOWN, KILL, or SUSPEND can occur after the operator was told no host/process action occurred.
residuals.recommendation: Use a durable request-ID state machine with authenticated admission and terminal receipts. Report timeout as PENDING and reconcile exactly once; cancellation must be a pre-mutation compare-and-set, never an inference from timeout.

residuals.title: Receipt authority loss between authorization and publication is not detected
residuals.evidence: Inert mid-transaction authority loss allowed ECO to apply and produced an empty-HMAC mobile_change_receipt while the response text called its random ID a signed receipt.
residuals.impact: An in-process integrity fault can remove authoritative audit evidence without changing the operator-facing claim.
residuals.recommendation: Commit and reverify the exact receipt under a stable authority epoch before calling it signed; compensate reversible operations on failure and preserve irreversible operations as PENDING until their durable consumer receipt reconciles.

assurance_boundary: No unauthenticated remote action path was reproduced. The remaining issues occur after a valid authorization or an in-process bus-integrity fault and affect atomicity, late completion, and evidence truthfulness.

focused_validation.command: python -m py_compile (Mobile Bridge, Combat, EventBus, BaseModule, reattack test)
JSON parse and targeted git diff --check
